title: Integrate proposal, Codex handoff, and reconciliation
summary: Close the principal reliability and recovery gap: produce reviewed BoardCommands and proposals, hand them to implementation, and compare imported baseline, approved change, and final code.
acceptance_criteria: Implement and verify the reliability outcome: produce reviewed BoardCommands and proposals, hand them to implementation, and compare imported baseline, approved change, and final code.
Identify the critical invariants and the harm caused by violating each one.
Define authoritative state, derived state, cache, persistence, external source, and projection boundaries.
Make operations idempotent or explicitly non-repeatable with protected receipts.
Handle duplicate input, reordering, cancellation, timeout, retry, and out-of-order completion.
Handle restart, crash, partial write, partial network response, and interrupted migration.
Handle stale, unavailable, corrupt, unknown-version, and permission-denied inputs.
Preserve user work and source data whenever the product contract requires it.
Provide atomic save, transaction, checkpoint, rollback, compensation, restore, or safe stop as appropriate.
Add deterministic failure injection and recovery fixtures.
Add migration fixtures from every currently supported persisted format.
Add security, privacy, credential, and path-traversal tests where relevant.
Add concurrency and race tests for shared mutable state.
Add property or invariant tests for mathematical, financial, scheduling, puzzle, or identity domains where applicable.
Provide user-facing recovery and support evidence without leaking private data.
Record evidence class and runtime limitations.
Connect the behavior to the repository assurance plan.
Update lifecycle, backup, restore, and support documentation.
Do not weaken validation or suppress warnings to complete the slice.
Run the strongest practical verification and record environmental blockers.
Finish with zero app-owned warnings.

agent_notes: Non-scope: do not perform release, deployment, signing, external publication, destructive data operation, irreversible migration, or product merger.
Alternative considered and rejected: creating another abstract planning layer without implementable milestones would continue planning instead of delivering value.
Every implementation slice must be small, reviewable, evidence-backed, and warning-free.
Product role: internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace.
